result.title: SegPFN: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks
result.comment: 18 pages, including 8 pages of supplementary material
result.summary: In-context segmentation (ICS) uses one or a few annotated reference images to specify what to segment in a target image. Existing training-free ICS approaches typically rely on manually designed inference procedures, which may limit how flexibly reference information is combined. Learned in-context inference offers an adaptive alternative, but acquiring this capability through segmentation-specific training can compromise generalization to unseen domains. We therefore ask: can a pretrained in-context learner infer what to segment from annotated references without segmentation-specific training? We introduce SegPFN, a training-free framework that reformulates ICS as tabular classification over frozen visual features. A frozen tabular prior-data fitted network (PFN) uses labeled reference patches as context to classify patches in the target image. We comprehensively benchmark SegPFN against major existing ICS methods across 11 datasets spanning semantic, part, and personalized segmentation. SegPFN improves overall mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) by 4.7 points over the strongest overall baseline and achieves the highest average mIoU in four of five task-shot settings. Further analyses show that hard-negative reference patches improve fine-grained target discrimination, while joint conditioning enables SegPFN to use multiple references effectively. These results show that SegPFN offers a simple and effective paradigm for training-free in-context segmentation.

AI.brief_summary: SegPFN 将 in-context 分割重构为对冻结视觉特征的 patch 级表格分类：由预训练表格 PFN 以带标注参考 patch 为上下文推断目标图像各 patch 标签，无需分割专用训练，并在 11 个数据集的语义、部件与个性化分割任务上对比现有 ICS 方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用 PFN 的隐式后验实现免训练的上下文证据组合，并显示 hard-negative 参考 patch 能提升细粒度判别，这一「参考视觉证据如何筛选与融合」的做法可能为 LVR 的证据选择与条件化设计提供核查线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或生成过程。
